summary: Comprehensive QA analysis of existing commands system. Created test suite validating structure, content, naming conventions, and cross-references. All core tests pass. Identified edge cases and one portability bug.

save.md.purpose: Quick checkpoint with workspace-wide sanity check

endsession.md.purpose: Full session close-out with memory update

edge_cases_found.description: Long command names: No validation for max length
Special characters in names: Underscores, numbers not tested
edge_cases_found.recommendation: Define naming spec (kebab-case only vs allowing underscores)

edge_cases_found.description: Empty frontmatter: Skills with empty name/description
edge_cases_found.recommendation: Sanity check should validate frontmatter values not just presence

edge_cases_found.description: Broken references: Commands may reference missing files
edge_cases_found.recommendation: Add file existence validation to sanity check

edge_cases_found.description: Circular deps: /save references sanity check, but what if sanity check fails?
Unicode content: Emoji and special chars in command descriptions
edge_cases_found.recommendation: Generally works, but test on different terminals

bugs_found.details: Path C:\Users\<user>\workspace will not work on other machines or OSes
bugs_found.recommendation: Use relative paths or environment variables for portability
bugs_found.example_fix: cd $WORKSPACE_ROOT or cd $(pwd) assuming run from workspace dir

ui_requirements: Show command categories (session, git, meeting, reflection)
Show which commands can be auto-triggered

auto_trigger_candidates.trigger: End of day or extended inactivity

integration_points: Commands should update blackboard when run
Commands could trigger other agents (e.g., /audit could spawn qa-tester)
Command execution status could show in Flight Path

handoff_notes: Test suite is ready. Frontend dev should build the Command Center UI. Backend dev should expose command metadata via API. DevOps should integrate tests into CI. All commands are well-structured and follow conventions.
